lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Elysium Colony. Year 2387. A diagnostic skiff hangs over the Whispering Woods.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Dr. Kaela Osei was only meant to run a routine orbital pass on Gaia — the planet's caretaker system.

lines.speaker: GAIA
lines.text: Identity query. Who is on this channel?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The channel flared. Instruments died. The skiff tore through the canopy — and Kaela woke in the wreckage, Gaia already waiting in the trees.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Far above, the United Earth Coalition noticed too — and they mean to erase Gaia. Talk to her. Find two glowing memory fragments. Walk south to the City. Do not let them wipe her record.

panels.then: title card ECHOES OF ELYSIUM over the upper sky, fade into the Woods
